task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones are in stock, then find a couple of popular audio alternatives for me and format those recommendation details into a readable summary. After that, scan my living room devices, check the living room light’s current status, use that to set its brightness to 70, then look up the discovered smart lock there, archive that lock discovery as “Living Room Lock Archive,” and finally create a shopping-and-IoT summary document from that archive and send me an app alert.

user_input.query: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk are in stock. Then find a couple of popular alternatives in the audio category and format those recommendation details into a readable summary. After that, scan my living_room devices for user_id u_alice, check the current status of the living room light device_id light_living, and use that to set its brightness property to 70 using config_value 70. Then find the discovered smart lock there, archive that lock discovery as “Living Room Lock Archive,” and create a shopping-and-IoT summary document from that archive. Finally, send me an alert through the app channel with medium priority.
